name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Between Grimsby and Ravenscroft, one goes with Library and the other with Governess.
If Heir does not go with Library, then either Fairfax goes with Chef or Conservatory goes with Grimsby.
Chef, Governess, and Heir go with Ravenscroft, Conservatory, and Library, in some order.
If Ravenscroft does not go with Lounge, then Heir does not go with Library.
Either Conservatory goes with Pierce or Library goes with Fairfax.
